points.description: States that a queue is a data structure (a collection that stores elements).
States that it follows the First In First Out (FIFO) principle, i.e. the element added first is removed first.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if FIFO is only named or only vaguely described (e.g. 'items leave in order') without clear explanation.

points.description: Names enqueue as a main operation (adds an element to the rear/end of the queue).
Names dequeue as a main operation (removes an element from the front of the queue).
